The best open-world games on PS Plus

Sometimes you just want a big world to get lost in. These are our ten favourite open-world games on PS Plus right now, from swinging over New York to sailing the Aegean in Ancient Greece. Each one says where it's set and roughly how long the main story takes, though you'll probably spend twice that wandering off the path. The full list of open-world games follows.

What counts as open world

An open-world game gives you a large, connected place to explore at your own pace, rather than leading you from level to level. You can usually go almost anywhere early on, take on side activities in any order, and come back to the main story when you're ready.

Open world is a way of building a game rather than a genre of its own, so this list mixes action games, RPGs and adventures. We count games whose world is open from early on, not ones that open up only near the end. The full list includes every game on PS Plus tagged as open world.

1

Marvel's Spider-Man 2

New York City · PS5 · Metascore 90 · 90% recommend on OpenCritic · about 17 h main story

Peter Parker and Miles Morales share the suit in a New York that now stretches into Brooklyn and Queens, taking on Kraven the Hunter and the Venom symbiote. Swinging, and now gliding on web wings, across the city never stops feeling amazing.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

Death Stranding 2: On the Beach

Mexico and Australia · PS5 · Metascore 89 · about 35 h main story

Sam Porter Bridges sets out again, this time across Mexico and Australia, to connect a broken world one delivery at a time. It's Hideo Kojima at his strangest and most ambitious, and planning a route across wild terrain is oddly gripping.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

Horizon Forbidden West

The far-future American West · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 88 · about 29 h main story

Aloy heads west into the ruins of the American West Coast, where giant robotic animals roam overgrown cities and deserts. Taking down a towering machine piece by piece with a bow is one of the great sights in games.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut

Feudal Japan · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 83 · 97% recommend on OpenCritic · about 25 h main story

In 1274, the Mongols invade the island of Tsushima, and samurai Jin Sakai has to bend his code of honour to fight back. The island is one of the most beautiful worlds ever made, and the wind itself guides you to your next goal. This version includes the Iki Island expansion.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

Kingdom Come: Deliverance II

Medieval Bohemia · PS5 · Metascore 89 · about 55 h main story

It's 1403, and Henry, a blacksmith's son caught up in a civil war, has to make his way across a lovingly recreated medieval Bohemia. There's no magic and no dragons, just a world that reacts to everything you do and a story full of humour and heart.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

Assassin's Creed Odyssey

Ancient Greece, 431 BCE · PS4 · Metascore 83 · 83% recommend on OpenCritic · about 46 h main story

You're a Spartan mercenary, playing as Kassandra or Alexios, caught up in the war between Athens and Sparta. Ancient Greece is a joy to wander, from marble cities to quiet olive groves, and your own ship carries over the sailing and sea battles that made Black Flag such fun.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Fallout 4

Post-apocalyptic Boston · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 87 · about 28 h main story

You emerge from a fallout shelter 200 years after the bombs, into the irradiated ruins of Boston, searching for your kidnapped son. You can lose yourself for weeks scavenging, building settlements and following strange side stories.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Hogwarts Legacy

Hogwarts and the Scottish Highlands · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 84 · 88% recommend on OpenCritic · about 27 h main story

You're a new fifth-year student at Hogwarts in the 1800s, with a rare gift for ancient magic. Exploring the castle, flying over the Highlands and learning spells is everything a Harry Potter fan could want.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Far Cry 3 Classic Edition

A tropical island chain · PS4 · Metascore 88 · 67% recommend on OpenCritic · about 16 h main story

Jason Brody's holiday goes horribly wrong when pirates take his friends captive on a tropical island run by the unforgettable Vaas. It set the template for every Far Cry since, and its villain is still one of the best.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Gravity Rush 2

Floating cities in the sky · PS4 · Metascore 80 · about 19 h main story

Kat can shift gravity at will, falling sideways and upwards through floating comic-book cities. It's a wonderfully unusual way to explore, and a cult PlayStation favourite that deserves more players.

Questions

What's the best open-world game on PS Plus?

Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is the highest-rated open-world game in the Extra catalogue, at 90. For something you can sink a hundred hours into, Kingdom Come: Deliverance II or Fallout 4.

What's the biggest open-world game on PS Plus?

For sheer size and things to do, Kingdom Come: Deliverance II, Fallout 4, Skyrim and Assassin's Creed Odyssey can each take well over 100 hours if you do everything. Our long games list has more.

What's a good open-world game for beginners?

Marvel's Spider-Man 2 and Hogwarts Legacy are easy to pick up and fun just to move around in. Ghost of Tsushima has gentle difficulty settings and a world that guides you.

Is Red Dead Redemption on PS Plus?

Not at the moment. The original Red Dead Redemption used to stream as a PS3 game with PS Plus Premium, but it's no longer on the service, and Red Dead Redemption 2 isn't on PS Plus either.

Are there open-world games I can play with friends?

Far Cry 5 and Far Cry 4 let a friend join for the whole campaign, and Ghost of Tsushima has a co-op mode. Our online co-op list has more.

Which Assassin's Creed games are on PS Plus?

Several, including Black Flag, Origins, Odyssey and Valhalla. Black Flag is the best place to start if you like pirates, and Odyssey if you want a huge RPG.
